task_definition.task_description: Please check the weather in Tokyo and get the alert details so you can post a weather alert card for me. After that, book an economy seat on flight CA1234 for me, look up the latest business news, find some trending product recommendations similar to the Sony XM5 black headphones, and finally, show me what coupons I have available.

user_input.query: Hi there! Could you please check the current weather in Tokyo and get all the alert details so you can post a weather alert card for me? Once that's done, I'd like you to book an economy seat on flight CA1234. I also need you to look up the latest business news to keep me updated. Additionally, please find some trending product recommendations that are similar to the Sony XM5 black headphones, specifically using the reference p_sony_xm5_blk. Finally, for my account default_user, could you show me what coupons I have available? Thanks!
